overall_reason: A recent-deploys list that gives each row a full anatomy (status, badge, time, commit meta), but the badge track squeezes the meta line to 120 to 141px, so every meta line is cut mid-word.

score.reason: T-SQUINT reads title and Deploy first and three even rows after, but T-DENSITY-FIT finds the row grid too narrow for its meta line on all three rows.

findings.where: meta line of all three rows, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json the text column is 140, 120 and 141px wide because the status badges ('live', 'building', 'failed') take a track of their own; the meta lines 'main · 8f2c1a4 · Maya Chen · 42s', 'perf/search · b41e09d · Jon Park · 42s' and 'copy/pricing · 3a7f6c2 · Ana Ruiz · 42s' render cut as 'Maya Chen ·', 'b41e09d · J' and '3a7f6c2 · Ana' in 01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png.
findings.before: Four fields per row in a 296px card: text column 120 to 141px, meta line clipped on every row.
findings.after: Move the badge onto the meta line or below the name so the text column runs to the time track, or drop the commit hash at this width.
findings.why: Every row loses the author or the duration, so the extra density costs the facts it was added to show.

strengths: Every row follows one template: status icon, name, meta line, badge, time.
